name: lathliss_two_dragons_returned_together_make_two_dragons
notes: M8 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever another nontoken Dragon you control enters, create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.' Support card: FDN Raise the Past (verified; 'Return all creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.'). Two Dragon creature cards return to seat 0's battlefield at the same time: each is a Dragon entering, so Lathliss triggers twice (once per Dragon, not once for the event) and seat 0 gets two Dragon tokens.
